messages:
anna: Putting together a compact playbook for the EU model cutover that needs: tenant opt-outs, KMS blackout alignment, canary + A/B semantic checks, and a fast degrade path. Goal: minimal blast radius, clear owners.

mike: TL;dr on canary sizes?

anna: Plan: steady 4-stage ramp: 3% -> 10% -> 25% -> 60%. Each stage is a 20m watch window. Auto-eval at 10% and 25% with semantic diff; immediate rollback if fail.

devon: For capacity issues prefer model downgrade (quantized variant) before geo-failover. Geo-failover only if latency grossly exceeds SLO or model not available.

lena: Flag policy: `switch.eu.model.v3.enabled`. Fields: owner, ttl, tenant_exceptions, kms_blackout, emergency_owner. I'll draft YAML.

anna: Owners: product (anna) runway/approval, infra (lena) for flag ops, runtime (devon) for fallback automation, QA (qa) for semantic checks.

mike: Semantic checks = prompt-set A/B + embed-similarity delta? threshold?

qa: We'll run the canonical prompt-set (200 prompts) and compute pass if >95% of outputs have BLEU/ROUGE/emb-sim within tolerance. At 10% checkpoint we'll run a fast sample (50 prompts).

devon: Automation pseudocode (high level):
```bash
if gate_failed_for(2 windows):
  disable_flag(switch.eu.model.v3.enabled)
  enable_fallback(model:v3-quant)
  route_eu_to(previous_variant)
  post_snapshot(telemetry, example_traces)
  notify(#incidents, oncall)
```

lena: Tenant exceptions: ops to provide list. Config will support `tenant_exceptions: ["cust-acme", "gov-eu-bank"]` so those remain on prior model and require manual opt-in.

ops: Confirmed: we'll provide tenant_exempt list by EOD. Also KMS rotation window next Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC  must not overlap canary. Add `kms_blackout: ["2025-06-10T02:00Z/2025-06-10T04:00Z"]` to be safe.

anna: Runbook (condensed):
- Preflight (owner lena): flag YAML PR + validate infra quotas + confirm KMS blackout clear.
- Stage 0: enable 3% for 20m. Basic health (5xx, p90 latency).
- Stage 1: 10% for 20m. Run quick 50-prompt semantic eval. If pass -> continue.
- Stage 2: 25% for 20m. Run full 200-prompt eval + compare QoE metrics.
- Stage 3: 60% for 30m. Monitor long-tail latencies and cost.
- Recovery: if any stage fails -> immediate disable flag -> enable quantized fallback -> if tenant in exceptions do manual ops path and notify customer success.

mike: What about telemetry snapshots for offline analysis?

devon: capture: request/response pairs for failing cohorts, model logits summary, cache hit rate, and prefix-KV fullness. We'll store snapshot in `s3://redwood-rollouts/eu-model-v3/snapshots/{ts}` with restricted ACL.

qa: Add a QA gate that checks hallucination rate on 200 prompts; threshold 2%. Fail -> rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2050045600 (Wed 09:00 UTC). Will execute slices and emit stage events.

ops: Reminder: enterprise EU tenants with contractual geo constraints must be excluded by default. We'll confirm list.

lena: I'll submit flag YAML PR with fields: owner, ttl=12h, tenant_exceptions, kms_blackout, emergency_owner, stages=[3,10,25,60], windows_mins=[20,20,20,30], semantic_check_points=[10,25], rollback_policy. PR by tomorrow noon.

anna: Next actions: lena PR flag spec; devon implement fallback + snapshot hooks; qa wire eval into CI to run at checkpoints; ops publish tenant_exempt list and confirm KMS windows. We'll meet 30m before deploy. :thumbsup:

mike: ack. I'll also add a small customer-comm template for ops to use if manual opt-outs cause delays.

anna: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread as source of truth for the cutover notes and incidents link.

qa: small note: include a post-mortem template in the PR so we capture lessons if rollback occurs.

anna: added. End.
